:host{display:block}.har-review-shell{border:0;padding:0;margin:0;min-width:0}.har-review-recovery{margin:18px 24px}.har-review-recovery h2{margin-top:0}.har-review-pending{padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid #ccc}.har-review-pending p{margin:0 0 8px}.har-review-close{margin:14px 24px}

STELLAR FORGE / CUSTOMER INTEGRATION

OpenWeather workspace

Current weather and hourly timelines, with retained source and recoverable delivery.

Connecting…

Customer project

Use the customer's location and chosen unit mode. Credential values stay in the server environment.

New

Account call allowance

Set a local accounting window within the existing account's allowance. Every attempted provider page is counted, including failures and interrupted requests. Record calls made by other applications.

Customer API inventory

Import the customer's original OpenAPI JSON or YAML. The maintained SF61 inspector retains the exact source, operations, backend authentication and request contracts.





Reviewed field and unit contract
One Call 4.0 uses a data array. Missing measurements stay absent. Rain and snow remain mm/h in every mode; precipitation probability remains a fraction. UTC timestamps remain exact, and local display uses the returned IANA time zone.
Original One Call 4.0 documentation






Acquire current and hourly data
The end of the hourly window is exclusive. Provider continuation links determine each next page.










Acquisitions


Selected acquisition








Scheduled refresh
Schedules use the same retained call allowance and saved project revision. The provider recommends a ten-minute interval. Automatic selection requires the first edition to have been reviewed; incomplete or conflicting refreshes remain for inspection.








Review and deliver
Inspect the actual retained range before accepting a data edition. Existing editions remain available when a project or acquisition changes.


Acquisition review
Select an acquisition.




Saved customer editions




Direct clients can use /weather/PROJECT/active/current. Exported merchant releases bind an exact immutable edition. Hourly client pagination pins its first returned edition.


Node / TypeScript client


Workspace recovery
The weather backup includes all projects, imported source, provider records, call accounting, decisions and data editions. Keep the original merchant packages and release store in the same host backup.
node openweather/cli.mjs restore --store NEW_PRIVATE_DIRECTORY --file BACKUP.json






Review the customer API integration
Export through the original SF61 merchant compiler. Refreshing an existing package preserves its route identities, atomic prices and payment settings.


Saved integration reviews
Reopen the exact reviewed source and package inputs to continue an export after a restart.









Complete source / effective comparison










Stage, run and recover
The original SF82 release operator owns selection, startup, drain and rollback. Review its actual generation and source comparison before selecting.






Original release comparison




Provider credentials remain in the launch environment. Source, accounting and recovery stay with this private customer workspace.
